_comment: Checked-in fixture for playbooks/check-env-templates.yml's 'optional vars' scenario. Values are dummy/non-secret placeholders that only need to be non-empty -- never real credentials. Enables every optional worker feature so check-required-env.py can prove APNS_*/NTFY_*/GLITCHTIP_DSN/SIGNAL_NOTIFIER_BEARER_TOKEN/DEMO_RESET_CRON reach a rendered .env (review round 2, 'also fix' #2: no dead vars).
_comment_admin_keys: Synthetic, structurally valid (64 lowercase hex, and distinct from each other) stand-ins for the two admin keys -- NOT real keys, and not derived from any seed. They exist so the render exercises the ADMIN_PUBKEY -> ADMIN_DECRYPTION_PUBKEY pairing config.ts enforces at startup (#1283). vars.example.yml leaves both empty, which is the other valid state (admin bootstrapped from the desktop app), so only this scenario can prove the templates emit them together.
_comment_1624: Added with #1624. Each of these switches on a var the worker READS and that no render previously reached, so scripts/check-consumed-env.py has a render to point at: SIP_BRIDGE_URL (asterisk), METRICS_SCRAPE_TOKEN (the Prometheus scrape bearer), SIP_REGISTRAR_SECRET + TURN_HOST/TURN_SECRET (the per-volunteer SIP registrar and its relay), and one <PROVIDER>_WEBHOOK_IPS line. Dummy non-secret placeholders, as above.
